label: endRunDropped: the forward to the kernel's endRun is dropped, so a drag after a save folds into the saved drag (a run spans two gestures) and undo skips past the saved catalog (Library's only endRun forward is endCoalescing; a save ends no run, since the window saves mid-drag)
refusalIsSuccess: the adapter maps the kernel's refusal of a newer catalog to success, so the newer file reads as damaged and is set aside
forwardDropped: the session no longer forwards the current revision, so a change never reads dirty
failedIsSaved: a failed save maps to the kernel's saved status
readOnlyDropped: a catalog that can't be saved over (loading, newer) reads as an ordinary saved one
probeUnbounded: the probe drops the supported version, so a newer catalog reads as damaged
dirtyIsSaved: the status stops reading the session's dirty flag, so an unwritten change reads saved
